approval.rationale: System boundaries, zero-dependency engine choice, and platform adapter interfaces approved.

data.systemOverview: Project Intelligence is a local-first, schema-driven AI project orchestrator framework. It decouples canonical schemas, lifecycle FSMs, anti-slop quality engines, and Git-aware memory from vendor-specific AI coding tools via declarative platform adapters.

components.name: Canonical Schemas Registry
components.responsibility: Defines draft-07 JSON Schemas for all 7 contracts, memory, lifecycle, agents, and skills.

components.name: Lifecycle State Machine Engine
components.responsibility: Enforces valid deterministic state transitions across gates G0 through G6.

components.name: Anti-Slop & Quality Evaluator
components.responsibility: Evaluates mandatory engineering baselines, specialized quality profiles, and verification honesty.

components.name: Git-Aware Memory Reconciler
components.responsibility: Synchronizes durable knowledge, execution state, and backlog with actual Git repository status.

components.name: Platform Translation Adapters
components.responsibility: Translates canonical instructions and skills to Claude Code, Copilot, Codex, and other AI runtimes.

technologyStack.rationale: Ubiquitous, zero-compilation, strong standard library support (json, unittest, pathlib, subprocess).
Universally portable machine-readable contract standard across all programming languages and AI tools.
Requires zero pip installations, guaranteed to execute immediately on any developer workstation or CI environment.

securityModel.secretsHandling: Zero secrets in memory or contracts. Secrets must only be sourced from environment variables or secure key vaults outside the Git tree.
securityModel.inputValidationPolicy: Strict JSON Schema validation on all inbound contracts; invalid schemas trigger fatal exit.
leastPrivilegePrinciples: Subagents have read-only access to files outside their designated workstream directory.
Shell command execution is restricted to authorized test and validation commands.
